Android TV 12 (API 31), firmware STT2.230526.001
ro.product.model=TPM191E  ro.product.device=PH9M_EA_5599
Fingerprint: Philips/PH9M_EA_5599/PH9M_EA_5599:12/STT2.230526.001/4215:user/release-keys
TP Vision build: MediaTek MT5887, vendor packages use the org.droidtv prefix.

Same board AND firmware build as examples/philips-75pus8505 and examples/philips-tpm191e (identical
fingerprint). Batches 1-3 follow the 8505 list, minus Apple TV, which this owner uses, and minus
usagelogger and demome (note 1). Batches 4 and 5 are this owner's unused streaming apps and Philips
web-app tiles.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/philips-65pus9435/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/philips-65pus9435/debloat.txt com.google.android.tvlauncher
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher
Live TV app:    org.droidtv.playtv
The uk.co.freeview.* packages and org.droidtv.freeviewplayers are disabled from the factory on
this unit, so they are not listed (restore.sh would turn them ON).

Notes from this unit:
1. Re-enabled at every boot, so left out below: com.phorus.playfi.tv (as on the 8505),
org.droidtv.usagelogger and org.droidtv.demome. disable.sh skips the last two anyway, as both ask
for TV_INPUT_HARDWARE. Neither serves android.media.tv.TvInputService here (only
com.mediatek.tvinput, org.droidtv.fastip and com.google.android.videos do), so that skip is a
false positive on this set; disabled with TVINPUT_ALLOW=1 they were back on after one reboot.
The other entries stayed disabled across two reboots. The 8505 and tpm191e lists disable
usagelogger (and the 8505 demome) with no such note, so other units may differ.
2. com.google.android.tvrecommendations went off while the stock launcher was still Home, the
order the 8505 notes warn against. The stock home still drew and opened apps afterwards, and
build-and-install.sh moved Home without trouble, so on this unit the order did not matter.
3. Launcher: build-and-install.sh ran through on its own, without the `am start -W` timeout the
8505 saw (cold start 2.2 s), and Home resolved to com.gathin.tvhome. config.xml used:
live_tv_package org.droidtv.playtv; hidden_apps org.droidtv.playtv, org.droidtv.demome,
org.droidtv.eum, org.droidtv.channels, com.vewd.core.browserui (hidden, not disabled: eum and
channels back the SOURCES drawer, vewd is the HbbTV engine).
4. Private DNS set to dns.adguard-dns.com (mode hostname); Netflix still plays. Both settings were
null before. Undo: settings delete global private_dns_mode; settings delete global private_dns_specifier
5. Checked with the real remote after the launcher took over: Home, SOURCES drawer, the launcher's
Inputs menu, Ambilight, and casting YouTube from a phone.

Kept on purpose: Ambilight (org.droidtv.ambihuecommon, org.droidtv.ambiair, org.droidtv.alhuewizard),
Chromecast (com.google.android.apps.mediashell), firmware updates (org.droidtv.oad, com.easy.oad),
the HbbTV browser engine (com.vewd.core.browserui), ARTE and ARD Mediathek web apps
(org.droidtv.nettvapp1814, org.droidtv.nettvapp3093), and everything in the DO NOT DISABLE block of
examples/philips-75pus8505 (org.droidtv.eum, org.droidtv.fastip, org.droidtv.settings, USB media).
